Experimental results of the manuscript:

 

“Mixed Noise Removal via Laplacian Scale Mixture Modeling and Nonlocal Low-rank Approximation”

 

By Tao Huang, Weisheng Dong, Guangming Shi, and Xiang Bai, submitted to IEEE Trans. On Image Processing.

 

Note:

(1) The mixed noise removal method in [1] is labeled as “TPD”;

(2) The mixed noise removal method in [2] is labeled as “BM3D*”;

(3) The mixed noise removal method in [3] is labeled as “SLR”;

(4) The mixed noise removal method in [4] is labeled as “WESNR”;

(5) The variant of the proposed denoising method based L1-norm is labeled as “L1_NLR”;

(6) The variant of the proposed denoising method based L0-norm is labeled as “L0_NLR”;

(7) The proposed mixed noise removal method is labeled as “LSM_NLR”.

 

Then, the denoised image by the method LSM_NLR on the image Lena is labeled as “Lena_LSM_NLR.png”. Other denoised images are labeled similarly.

 

Evaluation metrics:

(1) The image quality assessment in [5] is labeled as “FSIM”;

(2) The image quality assessment in [6] is labeled as “VIF”;

(3) The image quality assessment in [7] is labeled as “IFC”;

(4) The image quality assessment in [8] is labeled as “SSIM”;

 

The original test images:    the set of 12 images      BSD100 dataset

References:

[1] J. Cai, R. H. Chan, and M. Nikolova, “Two-phase approach for deblurring images corrupted by impulse plus gaussian noise,” Inverse Problem Imag., vol. 2, no. 2, pp. 187–204, 2008.

[2] K. Dabov, A. Foi, V. Katkovnik, and K. Egiazarian, “Image denoising by sparse 3-d transform-domain collaborative filtering,” IEEE Trans. Image Process., vol. 16, no. 8, pp. 2080–2095, Aug. 2007.

[3] H. Ji, S. Huang, Z. Shen, and Y. Xu, “Robust video restoration by joint sparse and low rank matrix approximation,” SIAM J. Imag. Sci., vol. 4, no. 4, pp. 1122–1142, 2011

[4] J. Jiang, L. Zhang, and J. Yang, “Mixed noise removal by weighted encoding with sparse nonlocal regularization,” IEEE Trans. Image Process., vol. 23, no. 6, pp. 2651–2662, Jun. 2014

[5] L. Zhang, L. Zhang, X. Mou, and D. Zhang, “Fsim: a feature similarity index for image quality assessment,” IEEE Trans. Image Process., vol. 20, no. 8, pp. 2378–2386, Aug. 2011.

[6] H. Sheikh and A. Bovik, “Image information and visual quality,” IEEE Trans. Image Process., vol. 15, no. 2, pp. 430–444, 2006.

[7] H. R. Sheikh, A. C. Bovik, and G. De Veciana, “An information fidelity criterion for image quality assessment using natural scene statistics,” IEEE Trans. Image Process., vol. 14, no. 11, pp. 2117– 2128, Dec. 2005.

[8] Z. Wang, A. C. Bovik, H. R. Sheikh, and E. P. Simoncelli, “Image quality assessment: From error visibility to structural similarity,” IEEE Trans. Image Process., vol. 13, no. 11, pp. 600– 612, Apr. 2004.
